programs.name: sualford
programs.purpose: Rotate four shear-wave component volumes to estimate fast and slow shear directions.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUALFORD - trace by trace Alford Rotation of shear wave data volumes

params.name: ntraces
params.description: Number of traces mixed for each rotation estimate.

params.name: xcorr_key
params.description: Header word for maximum normalized correlation.

params.name: taper
params.description: Overlap taper in samples at the rotation boundary.

params.name: Total
params.description: Limit on traces processed; zero means no explicit limit.

params.name: maxlag
params.description: Maximum acceptable shear lag in milliseconds.

params.name: tmin
params.default: computed: first S11 trace delrt divided by 1000
params.description: Start time of analysis window in seconds.

params.name: tmax
params.default: computed: first S11 trace delrt/1000 plus (ns-1)*dt
params.description: End time of analysis window in seconds.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Angle search, quality and cross-correlation accumulate floating-point values in a fixed order, use trigonometry and sinc interpolation, and mix float and double expressions. The code contains fragile indexing and initialization assumptions; its volume-opening dt check compares the pointer rather than the header-derived value.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines four-volume buffering, angle search, interpolation, correlation, and header conversion in more than 1500 lines.

test_cases.description: Rotate four small component volumes with a single-trace mix.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && sualford inS11=in.su inS12=in.su inS21=in.su inS22=in.su outS11=o11.su outS12=o12.su outS21=o21.su outS22=o22.su ntraces=1 angle_inc=10 taperwin=4

test_cases.description: Exercise a restricted analysis window and alternate taper and header settings.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && sualford inS11=in.su inS12=in.su inS21=in.su inS22=in.su outS11=o11.su outS12=o12.su outS21=o21.su outS22=o22.su ntraces=3 tmin=0.04 tmax=0.3 taper=0 taperwin=4 maxlag=20 Total=4 Az_key=otrav Q_key=grnlof

programs.license_note: Credits say the code was translated and adapted from Ted Schuck's original Fortran version.

programs.name: sueipofi
programs.purpose: Filter three-component traces using singular-value eigenimages and polarization weights.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUEIPOFI - EIgenimage (SVD) based POlarization FIlter for

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt divided by 1000000; 0.004 if zero

params.name: file
params.description: Base name for optional weight files.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: SVD, eigenimage reconstruction, powers, and spline interpolation are sensitive to operation order and math implementation. Linear interpolation passes iny[nin] as its right extrapolation value, an out-of-bounds read; samples after the last complete SVD window remain unfiltered.
programs.difficulty_reason: It performs windowed SVD and reconstructs and interpolates multiple polarization attributes for each three-trace group.

test_cases.description: Use cubic interpolation and write all weight files.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=120 ntr=6 | sueipofi dt=0.004 wl=0.08 interp=cubic pwr=1.5 file=eigen rl1=1 rl2=1 pln=1 > filtered.su
suplane nt=120 ntr=6 | sueipofi dt=0.004 wl=0.08 interp=linear pwr=2 > filtered.su

programs.license_note: The references include Numerical Recipes in C.

programs.name: suhrot
programs.purpose: Rotate the two horizontal components of each three-component trace group.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUHROT - Horizontal ROTation of three-component data

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle units: rad, deg, or gon.

params.name: a
params.description: User-supplied rotation angles; otherwise use afile or header coordinates.

params.name: x
params.description: Header positions corresponding to a; when omitted with a, one position is allocated.

params.name: key
params.description: Header word used to interpolate user angles.

params.name: n
params.description: Number of binary float values; required when afile is supplied.

params.name: xfile
params.description: Binary float positions; required when afile is supplied.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Rotation uses double-precision trigonometric functions and float storage. Without a or afile, nav is uninitialized but is read in the angle-conversion condition for non-radian units. The coordinate-derived angle is forced to zero whenever either coordinate difference is zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers three traces and interpolates optional station-dependent angles before rotation.

test_cases.description: Rotate by a supplied angle in degrees.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 | suhrot angle=deg a=30 x=0 inv=0 > rotated.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=6 | suhrot angle=rad inv=1 verbose=1 > rotated.su

programs.name: sultt
programs.purpose: Compute instantaneous polarization or asymmetry attributes from four shear-wave component volumes.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SULTT - trace by trace, sample by sample, rotation of shear wave data

params.name: outS11
params.description: Parsed output name; component-volume output is commented out.

params.name: outS12
params.description: Parsed output name; component-volume output is commented out.

params.name: outS21
params.description: Parsed output name; component-volume output is commented out.

params.name: outS22
params.description: Parsed output name; component-volume output is commented out.

params.name: alpha
params.description: Polarization-angle output volume for modes 2 and 3.

params.name: ntraces
params.description: Number of traces mixed at each location.

params.name: Total
params.description: Limit on traces processed; zero means no explicit limit.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sliding-window accumulation, eigenvalue formulas, angle calculations, and trigonometric functions depend on float rounding and operation order. The volume-opening dt check compares a pointer rather than the header-derived value; component output code is commented out.
programs.difficulty_reason: It mixes four buffered volumes and implements several windowed polarization and asymmetry calculations.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && sultt inS11=in.su inS12=in.su inS21=in.su inS22=in.su mode=1 wl=5 ntraces=1 theta=theta.su gamma=gamma.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && sultt inS11=in.su inS12=in.su inS21=in.su inS22=in.su mode=3 wl=7 ntraces=3 Total=4 alpha=alpha.su

programs.license_note: Credits say the code is based on algorithms presented by Li and Crampin and by Li and MacBeth.

programs.name: supofilt
programs.purpose: Filter three-component traces using direction and weighting attributes from separate SU files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPOFILT - POlarization FILTer for three-component data

params.name: dfile
params.description: SU file containing three polarization-direction traces per group.

params.name: wfile
params.description: SU file containing one weighting trace per group.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt divided by 1000000; 0.004 if zero

programs.float_sensitive_notes: pow and smoothing accumulation depend on math implementation and float rounding. An odd smoothing length sums isl-1 samples but divides by isl; boundary samples are zeroed.
programs.difficulty_reason: It synchronizes three trace streams and optionally applies a moving-window filter.

test_cases.description: Generate polarization attributes and apply smoothed filtering.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && supolar < in.su dt=0.004 wl=0.08 file=polar && supofilt < in.su dfile=polar.dir wfile=polar.rl dt=0.004 smooth=1 sl=0.04 wpow=2 dpow=1.5 > filtered.su
suplane nt=128 ntr=6 > in.su && supolar < in.su dt=0.004 wl=0.08 file=polar && supofilt < in.su dfile=polar.dir wfile=polar.rl smooth=0 wpow=1 dpow=2 > filtered.su

programs.name: supolar
programs.purpose: Analyze three-component traces and write polarization attributes to SU files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPOLAR - POLarization analysis of three-component data

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt divided by 1000000; 0.004 if zero

params.name: win
params.description: Window shape: boxcar, hanning, bartlett, or welsh.

params.name: tau
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: ellip
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: pln
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: f1
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: l1
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: amp
params.default: computed: 1 if all is nonzero, otherwise 0

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle units: rad, deg, or gon.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Windowed covariance sums, iterative Jacobi eigensolutions, eigenvector signs, and transcendental functions affect exact results. The code shifts allocated pointers before their objects for one-based indexing; amp's quadratic-resultant loop can read beyond the end of a trace.
programs.difficulty_reason: It computes a covariance matrix and iterative eigensolution for each sample and writes many optional attributes.

test_cases.description: Write default direction and rectilinearity attributes.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 | supolar dt=0.004 wl=0.08 win=boxcar file=polar

test_cases.description: Exercise tapered windows and multiple attribute definitions.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=6 | supolar dt=0.004 wl=0.08 win=hanning file=polar all=2 angle=deg rlq=1.5 amp=0

programs.license_note: The references include Numerical Recipes in C and an SEG dictionary.
